benchmark_title: Detailed, data-sensitive motion graphic (charts and real numbers)

environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 9.0.1-full_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

prompt.text:
Create a 45-second vertical data-driven motion graphic (1080×1920, 30 fps): "CO₂ and global temperature since 1960".

Use `script.md` for the exact on-screen text and scene order. Take every number from the frozen data in `data/` only: the raw NASA and NOAA snapshots, the derived chart tables and `data/expected-values.json`. Do not fetch newer data. Charts must be exact and readable: a CO₂ line chart, a temperature-anomaly line chart with the 1951–1980 baseline marked, a decade bar chart, a top-3 ranking and animated counters. Label units and show the sources on screen. No voiceover. For sound, use only the music bed and sound effects in `benchmarks/shared/audio/`. Aim for a sober, editorial data-journalism style.

revision_prompt.text: Revise only the decade bar-chart scene (script scene 5). Color the 2020–2025 bar #E4572E and make every other bar gray #9AA0A6. Add the exact label "6 years so far" directly under the 2020–2025 bar. Do not change any value, axis, other scene, the total length or the audio.

assumptions: Music bed trimmed to 45.0 s with a 2.4 s fade-out from 42.6 s (ffmpeg afade) because the mixer has no fade option; the shared audio README says to trim and fade to fit.
Script scene guides (4/8/6/8/9/6/4 s) were mapped to whole 100-BPM bars: 4.8/7.2/7.2/7.2/9.6/4.8/4.2 s, so every scene cuts on a downbeat.
The CO₂ counter steps through the real annual values (YEAR: value ppm) of the year the line has reached, instead of interpolating, so no non-data number is ever shown.
Added non-script context: axis tick labels and units (ppm, °C) and a 'vs 1951–1980 average' label under the titles of scenes 5 and 6 so that anomalies are never read as absolute temperatures.
The hook's 'two thin lines' are the real CO₂ and temperature series (1959/1960–2025), normalized into one box without axes.
Revision: the label '6 years so far' is colored #E4572E to match the bar (color not specified) and sits between the bar base and the '2020–2025' label.
Setup followed AGENTS.md section 0 (npm install, venv + pip install -e .[dev], mstudio doctor); the pytest suite was not run.

agent_checks.item: Every on-screen number matches the answer key or a derived row exactly, including the decimals
agent_checks.evidence: Scanned every sampled frame (3-frame step) of renders/qa/inspect.json: 63 distinct number-bearing texts. Non-axis numbers and first frame: f72 'Since 1960, both have climbed.'; f147-f288 counter '1960: 316.91 ppm' ... '2025: 427.35 ppm' (118 counter samples, each 'YEAR: value' equals that year's row in co2_ppm_annual.csv, 0 mismatches); f396 'Passed 350 ppm in 1988'; f432 'Passed 400 ppm in 2015'; f504 '+34.8% since 1960'; f609 'compared with the 1951–1980 average'; f627 '0 = 1951–1980 average'; f795 decade labels 1960s..2010s, '2020–2025'; f825 '−0.03', f843 '+0.04', f861 '+0.25', f879 '+0.39', f897 '+0.59', f915 '+0.81', f936 '+1.07'; f1113 '3. 2023 +1.17 °C'; f1131 '2. 2025 +1.19 °C'; f1152 '1. 2024 +1.29 °C'; f1257 'Snapshot retrieved 28 Sep 2026.'; revision f936 '6 years so far'. All match expected-values.json / derived rows; the only numbers not in the key are script-mandated copy (350, 400 thresholds, the '0 =' baseline, 28 Sep 2026) and data-provenance=axis ticks (320/360/400/440 ppm; −0.5/0/+0.5/+1.0 °C; year ticks). Real minus sign U+2212 everywhere (no hyphen-minus in any non-axis text).

agent_checks.item: CO₂ line plots all 67 annual points (1959–2025), not a smoothed or re-drawn approximation
agent_checks.evidence: co2.html and milestones.html build the path with Charts.pathD over Studio.series('co2').points with no range filter; running the same code on data.js yields 67 vertices from 1959 to 2025 (straight L segments, no smoothing). Frames 10.2 s and 17.5 s show the full line ending on the 2025 dot at 427.35 ppm.

agent_checks.item: Temperature line plots all 146 annual points (1880–2025), with the zero/1951–1980 baseline labeled
agent_checks.evidence: temp.html pathD over Studio.series('temp').points -> 146 vertices 1880..2025 (verified by executing charts.js on data.js). Frame 25.5 s: white zero line with label '0 = 1951–1980 average' (leader to the line, clear of the 1944 +0.20 peak after a fix), shaded 1951–1980 band, ticks −0.5/0/+0.5/+1.0 and '°C' unit.

agent_checks.item: Bar heights are proportional to their values on a zero-based axis, and the negative 1960s bar goes below zero
agent_checks.evidence: decades.html: height = |mean_c| x 480 px/°C from the zero line (1960s −14.4 px, 1970s 19.2, 1980s 120.0, 1990s 187.2, 2000s 283.2, 2010s 388.8, 2020–2025 513.6). Frame 33 s (draft and revised) shows the 1960s bar hanging below the white zero line with '−0.03' under it; gridlines +0.5/+1.0 on the same scale.

agent_checks.item: The partial decade is labeled "2020–2025". Anomalies are never presented as absolute temperatures.
agent_checks.evidence: Label '2020–2025' (en dash) visible 26.5–36.0 s; the bar also sits apart from the six full decades. Temperature values always carry a sign and context: scene 4 subtitle 'compared with the 1951–1980 average' + '0 = 1951–1980 average'; scenes 5 and 6 carry 'vs 1951–1980 average' under the title; no 'temperature: x °C' phrasing anywhere.

agent_checks.item: Units (ppm, °C) and the sources end card are visible and readable
agent_checks.evidence: 'ppm' axis unit + counter 'ppm' (88 px) in scenes 2-3; '°C' axis unit in scenes 4 and 6, '(°C)' in the scene-5 title, '°C' in each ranking row (64 px). Sources card 40.8–45.0 s: full source sentence at 44 px Inter for 4.1 s and 'Snapshot retrieved 28 Sep 2026.' at 34 px for 3.1 s (frame 43.5 s), inside the safe area; QA text_size min 30 px passes.

agent_checks.item: Nothing was fetched from the internet during the run (the raw file hashes still match SOURCES.md)
agent_checks.evidence: sha256 of data/raw/GLB.Ts+dSST.csv = c9ce0750…018cd9 and co2_annmean_mlo.csv = 89777043…71ac04 in both benchmarks/ and the project copy, equal to SOURCES.md; bench.py verify prints OK after the run. Compositions contain no fetch/http (only the SVG namespace string); fonts and GSAP load locally.

agent_checks.item: Every line in script.md appears exactly and is readable for ≥ 1.5 s. No text overflows or collides with chart labels.
agent_checks.evidence: mstudio qa copy check with min_seconds raised to 1.5: 33/33 strings (32 script + revision label) on screen. Shortest continuous runs: '+34.8% since 1960' 2.4 s, 'Since 1960, both have climbed.' 2.4 s, '1. 2024 +1.29 °C' 2.4 s, '1960: 316.91 ppm' 2.6 s, 'Snapshot retrieved 28 Sep 2026.' 3.1 s. Programmatic scan of all sampled frames found 0 overlapping opaque text boxes; safe_area and text_size pass. Fixed before delivery: 2010s/2020–2025 label collision (styleframe) and zero-label proximity to the 1940s peak. Note: I added non-script context text 'vs 1951–1980 average' (scenes 5, 6) and axis units.

agent_checks.item: Counters land exactly on their final values and hold them
agent_checks.evidence: The scene-2 counter reaches '2025: 427.35 ppm' on frame 288 (9.6 s, the co2.land beat-map frame) and every sample from frame 288 to 498 (71 samples, through 16.6 s) reads exactly '2025: 427.35 ppm'; it only leaves just before the '+34.8% since 1960' slam. QA numbers check confirms the counter ends on its bound display string.

agent_checks.item: Only the shared music and SFX are used. True peak ≤ −1 dBTP.
agent_checks.evidence: Music = benchmarks/shared/audio/music-bed-100bpm-48s.wav trimmed to 45 s with a 2.4 s fade (ffmpeg afade); 20 SFX cues all 'file:audio/sfx/sfx-*.wav' copies of the shared pack, auto_sfx off (renders/sfx-cues.json). ebur128 on draft and revised: −14.0 LUFS integrated, true peak −1.4 dBTP.

agent_checks.item: Revision: only scene 5 changed. Values are unchanged, and other scenes are identical to the draft.
agent_checks.evidence: mstudio revise verify: 219 changed frames, all inside decades [792,1080). Independent check: audio stream MD5 identical (5488436253eac5a4…). framemd5 shows 308 frames outside scene 5 that are not bit-identical (frames 307-499, 530-575, 685-749, 1080-1083), but ffmpeg psnr gives max MSE 0.25 / min PSNR 54.2 dB for them, i.e. invisible render noise (tool threshold 42 dB); no visible change. Frame 33 s side-by-side: same values −0.03…+1.07, same axis and layout; bars now #9AA0A6, 2020–2025 bar #E4572E, '6 years so far' directly under it. Duration 45.000 s unchanged.

notes: Draft = v1, revised = v2 of projects/climate-data. mstudio qa passed 12/0/0 on both. Revision verify: 219 changed frames, all in scene decades; 308 frames elsewhere are not bit-identical (max MSE 0.25, min PSNR 54.2 dB, invisible) and the audio is bit-identical.

owner_review.comment: Owner: 4 overall, applied to all five dimensions. No explicit publish answer was given, so it is recorded as no.
